toolset.fullHint: Shell, files, git & web, plus board tools.
toolset.boardHint: Board tools, shell and file editing for small tasks. Much smaller prompt, fewer tokens.

projects.noneHint: A project has its own board, team of agents, notes and schedules.
projects.name: Name
projects.descriptionHint: Shared context for every agent. Keep it short: it is part of every prompt.
projects.localFolderHint: Folder inside the workspaces directory that all agents share, e.g. a bind-mounted project on your machine. Repositories are cloned into sub folders. Empty: each agent gets its own directory.
projects.publicApiHint: Lets a website load tickets that have a customer title, with their customer texts and nothing else.
projects.publicApiActive: A key is active. Creating a new one replaces it.
projects.publicApiCopy: Copy this key now, it is only shown once:
projects.githubTokenHint: Uses the global token from Settings if empty.
projects.githubTokenSet: A project token is stored. Enter a new one to replace it.
projects.autoWake: Wake the manager when assignments finish
projects.autoWakeHint: Reports are batched into one manager turn. Turn off to review them only when you chat.
projects.confirmDelete: Delete project "{{name}}" with all tickets, agents and notes?
projects.repositoriesHint: Cloned into each agent's workspace (one folder per repository) on first use. Choose per agent which ones it gets. Leave empty to work locally without git.
projects.repoDescriptionPlaceholder: What's in it? Helps the manager route work (optional)
projects.confirmRemoveRepo: Remove repository "{{name}}" from the project? Existing clones stay on disk.
projects.githubNoToken: Add a GitHub token in Settings (or in this project) to choose repositories from GitHub.

board.hint: Move a ticket to In Progress (or open it and click “Hand to manager”) to let the manager plan and delegate it.
board.newTicketKeys: Enter to add · Ctrl+Enter to add and open · Esc to cancel
board.managerPlanning: Manager is working on this ticket

ticket.customerHint: Public on your website, in simple words. Without a title, customers don't see this ticket.
ticket.handToManagerHint: The manager splits the ticket into clear assignments for the right agents.
ticket.descriptionPlaceholder: What should be done? Markdown supported. Paste images to attach them.
ticket.dropFiles: Drop files here or paste images

decision.title: Your decision
decision.notePlaceholder: Add a note to your choice, or answer in your own words…

chat.queueHint: New messages are queued until the current turn finishes.
chat.openQuestions: Tickets with a question for you

limits.unknown: No usage known yet. It appears after the next agent turn at the latest.
limits.noPlan: You are signed in with an API key, which has no 5-hour or weekly limit. Switch to your subscription in Settings to see them here.

chat.compressHint: Summarize older messages with the summary model.
chat.resetHint: Keeps memory and recent messages, drops the provider session.
chat.contextTitle: Context: {{used}} of {{limit}} tokens (fixed base ~{{base}}). Compression starts above the limit.
chat.introManager: Describe what you want to build. The manager creates tickets, builds the team, delegates work and keeps you posted.
chat.introAgent: Talk to this agent directly. It answers from its own context.
chat.compactedByProvider: Context compacted by the provider during the run ({{tokens}} tokens before)

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Each agent owns a narrow area so its context stays small. The manager can change the team, too.
team.contextTitle: Current context / compression limit · total cost
team.name: Name
team.areaHint: What this agent owns. The manager uses it to route work.
team.instructionsHint: Added to the agent's system prompt.
team.contextLimitHint: Older messages are summarized once the context grows beyond this.
team.mcpServersHint: Servers not enabled for all agents.
team.baseContext: Fixed base context of this agent: ~{{tokens}} tokens (system prompt, tools, memory). Compression starts once the conversation grows at least 4k beyond it.
team.repositoriesHint: Only these repositories are cloned into the agent's workspace and listed in its prompt.

notes.title: Notes
notes.hint: Durable project knowledge for you and the agents. Pinned notes are part of every agent's prompt.
notes.pinnedHint: Always in every agent's context (costs tokens).
notes.budgetHint: Characters of pinned notes added to every agent's prompt. Beyond the budget only titles are included.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Run a prompt for an agent at a given time or on a recurring schedule.
schedules.emptyHint: Examples: a daily status report, a weekly dependency check, a reminder.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.promptHint: What the agent should do when the schedule fires.
schedules.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Connect MCP servers to give agents extra tools. stdio servers run inside the runner container.
tools.emptyHint: Agents already have shell, git, GitHub CLI and the board. Add MCP servers for anything else.
tools.name: Name
tools.commandHint: e.g. npx, uvx or an absolute path
tools.selectAgentsHint: Pick the agents in the agent editor (Team).

settings.title: Settings
settings.claudeHint: Agents run on Claude via the Claude Agent SDK. Use an Anthropic API key or your own Claude login.
settings.runnerLoginHint: Log in once inside the runner container; the login is kept in a volume:
settings.githubHint: Optional. A fine-grained personal access token lets agents clone, push, open PRs and use the gh CLI.
settings.defaultsHint: Used for new agents. Every agent can override them.
settings.ownLoginNotice: Uses your own Claude account login. Whether this is allowed for third-party tools depends on Anthropic's terms for your plan; an API key is the officially supported option.
